verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕਦੂੰ ਗਿਆਰਹ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਹੋਇ ਘਰਬਾਰੀ ਅਉਧੂਤੁ ਸਦਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: eikadhoo(n) giaareh rudhr hoi gharabaaree aaudhoot sadhaiaa|

en.bdb: From one there became eleven Rudrs (Sivas).Even being a householder he was called a recluse.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਸਿਧ ਨਾਥ ਕਰਿ ਪਰਚਾ ਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: jatee satee sa(n)tokheeaa sidh naath kar parachaa laiaa|

en.bdb: He loved celebates, followers of truth, contented ones, Siddhs (the proven ones) and naths, controllers of senses.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਦਸ ਨਾਵ ਧਰਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਬਾਰਹ ਪੰਥ ਚਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: sa(n)niaasee dhas naav dhar jogee baareh pa(n)th chalaiaa|

en.bdb: Sannyasis adopted ten names and yogis also promulgated their twelve sects.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਰਸਾਇਣਾਂ ਤੰਤ ਮੰਤ ਚੇਟਕ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: ridh sidh nidh rasainaa(n) ta(n)t ma(n)t cheTak varataiaa|

en.bdb: Riddhi, siddhis (miraculous powers), treasures, rasciree (chemical elixir), tantra, mantra and conjurations were introduced.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੇਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਿਵਰਾਤ ਦਾ ਕਰਾਮਾਤ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਾਦੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: melaa kar sivaraat dhaa karaamaat vich vaadh vadhaiaa|

en.bdb: Sivaratri was celebrated as a fair and it increased the debates and the use of miraculous powers.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੋਸਤ ਭੰਗ ਸਰਾਬ ਦਾ ਚਲੈ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਭੁਗਤ ਭੁੰਚਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: posat bha(n)g saraab dhaa chalai piaalaa bhugat bhu(n)chaiaa|

en.bdb: The cups of hemp, opium and wine were consumed and enjoyed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਜਨਿ ਬੁਰਗੂ ਸਿੰਙੀਆਂ ਸੰਖ ਨਾਦ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਕਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: vajan buragoo si(n)n(g)eeaa(n) sa(n)kh naadh raharaas karaiaa|

en.bdb: Rules for blowing instruments, like singe - and the conch were set.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਜਗਾਇਨ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: aadh purakh aadhes kar alakh jagain alakh lakhaiaa|

en.bdb: The primal Lord was saluted and invoked with the shouts of Alakh (the Imperceptible) but no one had perceived the Alakh.
Without holy congregation all remained duped by delusions.
